entry_sequence.action: the first thing I focus on is a stop raid this just means that a low was put in before it was rated or broken
the next thing I look for is a market structure shift or displacement this means that a previous high was broken and aggressively moved over
the next thing I look for is where there is a little bit flexibility I generally like to see price move back into a discount of this price range here
the next thing I look for is some sort of PD array where generally I prefer to have a fair value gut or an order block but I will also use an OTE in this area as well as a breaker block

each one of these Concepts could be used as an entry model by themselves however I like to blend one two or three of these Concepts together for my personal strategy for example I will look for a fair value Gap in an optimal trade entry or I'll look for the box set up in an optimal trade entry

confluences.description: the next thing I could look for is a fair value gap which we have a very small one right here
an order block which would be this down close candle right here
breaker block would be these up close candles here before the raid on liquidity
taking that one step further by using an OTE I can see that this is our premium up here where I do not want to be longing and this Narrows down my discount range to my OTE right in here
and lastly for the Box setup I would be looking for price to reach into this area here

targets.description: then looking for buy side liquidity up here
if I was too partial and reach for those lows I talked about earlier
your target the initial highs from the morning and from there let runners run
